description: This file contains Metal shader kernels and C++ code for bitwise operations (and, or, xor, left shift, right shift) optimized for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It defines GPU kernels, utility functions, and dispatch mechanisms for tensor bitwise operations within the at::native::mps namespace.

methods.name: getMetalType
methods.description: Returns Metal shader type string for a given scalar type or tensor.

methods.name: getCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves the Metal pipeline state object for a given set of tensors and function name.

methods.name: handle_binary_op
methods.description: Performs a binary tensor operation (and, or, xor, shifts) on MPS, handling scalar and tensor cases.

methods.name: lshift_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel function for left shift operation on tensors.

methods.name: rshift_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel function for right shift operation on tensors.
